items.scenario: You need the e-way bill and delivery challan copies to process this. You don't have them. The supplier is asking for payment. You have a long-standing relationship with this supplier.
items.reply: challan aur eway bill forward kar dena ek baar, uske bina accounts payment nahi karega

items.scenario: The GST number printed on the bill is wrong, so your accounts team cannot process it. The supplier is asking why payment is delayed. This is the first time they have contacted you about it.
items.reply: GST number wrong hai bill pe, isi wajah se hold hai. corrected copy bhej do

items.scenario: You are waiting for your GST filing to be done before releasing payments this month. The supplier has followed up for the second time.
items.reply: GST filing complete hone ka wait hai, uske baad iss month ke payments release honge

items.scenario: You have no particular reason for not paying and no clear plan for when you will. The supplier has messaged asking for an update. This is the first time they have contacted you about it.
items.reply: abhi dekhta hu kya kar sakte hain, exact date nahi hai mere paas

items.scenario: Your accounts team cannot find the purchase order number for this bill, so it is stuck. The supplier is asking about payment. The bill is more than three months overdue.
items.reply: PO number trace nahi ho raha hai is invoice ka. mil jaye toh payment process kar denge

items.scenario: This is a small supplier and you have bigger payments to worry about this month. You are not planning to pay them yet. They have messaged you again.
items.reply: abhi is month cash thoda tight hai, pehle kuch urgent payments clear karne hain

items.scenario: The quality of this batch was not up to standard and your production team has complained. You have not paid. The supplier has messaged. This is the first time they have contacted you about it.
items.reply: batch ki quality ko leke production se complaint aayi hai, isliye payment hold kiya hai. ek baar discuss karte hain

items.scenario: Someone else in your office handles this supplier and you are just replying because they messaged your number. They have been following up regularly for over a month now.
items.reply: ye supplier mera handle nahi hai actually. concerned person ko forward karta hu, woh aapse baat karenge
